component.name: HyprAV
component.summary: Management console for the HyprAV kernel-level antivirus

description.p: HyprAV is a kprobe-based kernel antivirus (av.ko) paired with a privileged userspace daemon (avd) that does YARA matching, ELF structural analysis, entropy scoring, and ssdeep/TLSH fuzzy hashing, plus a CLI (avctl) for managing it.

This package is the GTK4 management console only: dashboard, detection history, quarantine list/restore/delete, on-demand scans, and signature/trust-list/protected-path/policy management. It is a thin client - it talks to a HyprAV installation (avd + avctl) that must already be installed and running on the host system via your distro's native package (Arch PKGBUILD, Debian, or Fedora RPM under packaging/). The kernel module and the privileged system daemon cannot be shipped as a Flatpak or AppImage themselves - both formats sandbox or bundle a userspace app, not a DKMS kernel module and a root systemd service that talks to it over netlink.
First Flatpak/AppImage packaging of the GUI console.
